title: Check Custom Bounds
text: 在仿真期间检查模型信号是否满足边界，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Amplitudes} 指定下界幅值；{Show Plot} 打开绘图窗口、{Show plot on block open} 指定双击模块以打开绘图、{Response Optimization} 打开 Response Optimizer、{Include upper bound in assertion} 指定检查信号是否满足上限、{Times} 指定上限时间向量、{Include lower bound in assertion} 指定检查信号是否满足下界、{Enable zero-crossing detection} 指定在界限边界处计算模型、{Enable assertion} 启用或禁用检查、{Simulation callback when assertion fails (optional)} 指定断言失败时要计算的表达式、{Stop simulation when assertion fails} 指定断言失败时停止仿真、{Output assertion signal} 指定创建输出信号，按实例取值。

ports.name: Port_1 (u)
ports.summary: 要对照指定边界检查的信号 scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Show plot on block open
params.values: 双击模块以打开绘图 off (default) | on

params.name: Include upper bound in assertion
params.values: 检查信号是否满足上限 on (default) | off

params.name: Times
params.values: 上限时间向量 [0 5; 5 10] (default) | two-element vector | two-column matrix | cell array

params.name: Amplitudes
params.values: 上限幅值 [1.1 1.1; 1.01 1.01] (default) | two-element vector | two-column matrix | cell array

params.name: Include lower bound in assertion
params.values: 检查信号是否满足下界 off (default) | on

params.name: Enable zero-crossing detection
params.values: 在界限边界处计算模型 on (default) | off

params.name: Enable assertion
params.values: 启用或禁用检查 on (default) | off

params.name: Simulation callback when assertion fails (optional)
params.values: 断言失败时要计算的表达式 ’’ (default) | MATLAB expression

params.name: Stop simulation when assertion fails
params.values: 断言失败时停止仿真 off (default) | on

params.name: Output assertion signal
params.values: 创建输出信号 off (default) | on
